Boycott Disney, ABC, and WGN folks. The Great Khan of the Great Lakes says "make it so."
www.chicagotribune.com/2025/09/18/j...
I haven’t vacationed in Florida since Covid. Too many Floridians go along with everything Trump and DeSantis want. I have gone to the Great Lakes three times though.
As a Floridian I get this a lot. "We are going to America and want to see the Great Lakes and go to Disney World"

I never was a Disney fan of any type except the Sunday night show back in the day.
Plus I grew up by Cedar Point and Lake Erie. I hope that Americans rethink where they spend their vacation funds $$. Cable choices.

As your next President, I will make The Great Lakes and its tributaries a top priority. Disneyworld costs a family thousands of dollars. Being able to sit on a beach, river bank or boat with your kids every weekend and enjoy nature is priceless. .bsky.social .bsky.social

Sad but true. DeSantis is a terrible governor. I live in Wisconsin and have many friends who've retired to Florida. With climate change, our winters are getting warmer and their summers are getting hotter. Living on the Great Lakes, we will never run out of fresh water. People are now moving back.

As much as I’m down with that, to really be successful we’d need a LOT more people for it to truly matter. I say this as a former marvel/disney boycotter. Like a drop in Lake Michigan. Hell, I’d even be down to organize a Super Bowl boycott for next year.
Cancel your Florida trip and come see why the #GreatLakes region is the best vacation destination in the country. Affordable, too
And yes, I'm speaking of young people. Not joking. Youth have so much to gain by relocating to the Blue Wall states of the Great Lakes.

Wisconsin is losing young people. I blame the weather. Really. You'd think young people would believe in climate change enough to want to remain in the states of the Great Lakes, but....they like the sun. There's a powerful stigma against our region, much of it created by those who left.

Spend your vacation money in another beautiful state. Need some Disney - go to Disneyland. Want beaches? Beaches all along the west coast or the Great Lakes. Need sweltering heat? Arizona is a dream right now. Need humidity? The Midwest has got you covered. BOYCOTT FLORIDA!

Boycott Florida. Spend your vacation money in another beautiful state. Need some Disney - go to Disneyland. Want beaches? Beaches all along the west coast or the Great Lakes. Need sweltering heat? Arizona is a dream right now. Need humidity? The Midwest has got you covered. BOYCOTT FLORIDA!

The problem is what young people _think_ is socially accepted/approved of. Of course we have students who are crazy rich, and first-gen or just middle-income students _can_ be intimidated by their peers’ unhinged spending and think they too can only mention the Amalfi coast and not Lake Michigan.
